title: ImUi Color Edit Popup Split v1
problem: Finish the next cleanup-only step after the editor `ColorEdit` model split by moving popup UI composition, picker bars, preset swatches, alpha preview helpers, and popup pointer handlers into a dedicated internal popup module without changing public behavior or runtime contracts.

repro.summary: Focused color-edit and source-policy gates prove the popup split preserves the completed popup, picker, alpha, numeric, and preset behavior while moving UI composition behind `controls::color_edit::popup`.

cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_surface_policy --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_adapter_smoke --no-fail-fast
